fields.retail_comparables: References to qualifying retail facts with asking or transaction basis.
fields.salvage_comparables: References to damaged vehicle facts with final sale status.
fields.excluded_candidates: Candidate IDs and explicit mismatch/access reasons.
fields.recall_evidence: Model campaigns and VIN specific open recall facts kept separate.
fields.net_recovery_examples: Deterministic examples only where gross sale and all required deductions are supported.
fields.valuation_status: research_only or insufficient_evidence; no settlement value.

fields.line_findings: Estimate line IDs joined to evidence fact IDs.
fields.match_status: exact_supported, mismatch, needs_fitment_review, or insufficient_evidence per candidate.
fields.price_components: Part, quantity, mandatory fees, shipping, core charge, and unknown components.
fields.comparisons: Comparable totals and deltas calculated using Decimal, or null with a reason.
fields.shop_checks: Published identity/certification facts and source authority.
fields.labor_checks: Same discipline, geography and date, with method and coverage gaps.

fields.resolved_window: Exact local pickup/return dates and times used for the run.
fields.existing_option: Internal mock or actual confirmed extension data with origin preserved.
fields.alternative_quotes: Different-supplier competitor quotes for matched rental context; each retains public retail or other rate basis.
fields.scenario_totals: Base rental benchmark totals and deltas. Transfer or switching costs appear only in a separate scenario.
fields.next_action: review_benchmark, retain_primary_response, or insufficient_evidence. No reservation action.

fields.loss_window_utc: Validated conversion of the supplied local time and uncertainty window.
fields.events: Source facts with event type, geometry/point, time, intensity and reporting status.
fields.geographic_matches: Computed distance or overlap with precision and method stated.
fields.temporal_matches: Computed overlap and explicit unknown timezone handling.
fields.source_coverage: Which categories, dates and jurisdictions were actually searched.

fields.brief: Cited narrative with facts separated from hypotheses and recommendations.
fields.findings: External fact references joined internally to allowed context references.
fields.contradictions: Conflicting sources with scope and date.
fields.open_questions: Items requiring shop, supplier, or internal verification.
fields.mcp_trace: Actual server label, discovered tool name, sanitized arguments, status, and source refs.
fields.outbound_audit: Fields sent outside and whether the private canary appeared.
